district_name: Ludlow-Mount Holly Unified Union School District

jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(5)(C) inventory: Ludlow-Mount Holly Unified Union School District, a unified union district in the Two Rivers Supervisory Union (member towns: Ludlow, Mount Holly). Operates the two elementary schools; tuitions grades 7-12.
Two Rivers Supervisory Union (official site; hosts the district's meeting archive and annual report).

board.org_name: Ludlow-Mount Holly Unified Union School Board

sources.note: Ludlow-Mount Holly UUSD: eight directors, residency allocated Ludlow 4 / Mount Holly 4, elected by the whole district electorate on a single Australian ballot (16 V.S.A. section 730(a)(2) modified at-large; Mount Holly merger Q&A quoting the articles). No per-member term expirations are published in any fetched current document -- all memberships carry no end (missing: the March 3, 2026 warning and the towns' certified returns). Two memberships are HELD: June Capron and Katie Murphy are verified current members (roll calls of August 20 and September 22, 2026) who filled the two seats the March 2026 ballot left open (both still "Open Seat" in the June 10, 2026 packet), almost certainly by appointment -- but no fetched document records their appointments or which town's seat each holds (missing: the board minutes between June 10 and September 22, 2026). Two Rivers SU site (official), hosting the 2025-2026 LMHUUSD Annual Report: board signature block of eight members (Ludlow: Beth Merrill, Jamie Dickey, Jenn Michalke, Kaitlyn Benson; Mount Holly: Julie McKenzie, David Martin, Kelly Tarbell, Katie Kleczkowski). The March 11, 2026 meeting packet's membership table shows the post-election board: Ludlow -- Michalke, Benson, Merrill, one Open Seat; Mount Holly -- Tarbell, Martin, Michel, one Open Seat. Roll calls of August 20 and September 22, 2026 add June Capron and Katie Murphy (see the post note).

Town of Mount Holly merger Q&A, December 2017 (official), describing the adopted Articles of Agreement: "The new board will be made up of 8 members, 4 from each town though they will be elected by the entire membership of both towns" -- the 16 V.S.A. section 730(a)(2) modified at-large pattern, matching the district's single Australian ballot voted in both towns.

directors.name: Kelly Tarbell
directors.note: Mount Holly; Board Chair. Continuing pre-election incumbent.

directors.name: Stephen Michel
directors.note: Mount Holly (seat assignment deduced from the March 11, 2026 packet's arithmetic -- three named Ludlow members plus one open seat per town; flagged). First seated at the March 11, 2026 post-ballot packet, with the two unfilled seats still shown open -- he won his seat at the March 3, 2026 ballot. The February 24, 2026 annual meeting scan prints "Steven Michel"; the board minutes print Stephen.

directors.name: Jamie Dickey
directors.note: Ludlow; on the pre-election board (Annual Report; March 11, 2026 table), absent from all board documents after the March 3, 2026 election. Whether her term expired or she resigned is not stated.

directors.name: Julie McKenzie
directors.note: Mount Holly (Vice Chair); departed as for Dickey.

directors.name: Katie Kleczkowski
directors.note: Mount Holly (Clerk); departed as for Dickey.
